item.title: [TIFF - Toronto Film Festival] TOMSON HIGHWAY: PERMANENT ASTONISHMENT Trailer | TIFF
item.description:
Since The Rez Sisters premiered in Toronto in 1986, Tomson Highway has gifted the world with a multitude of award-winning plays, musicals, books, and concerts inspired by the people and places he’s encountered during his seven decades of life. From his birth in a tent in Northern Manitoba to the premiere of his latest play, Rose, at the National Arts Centre, his extraordinary life is captured in the documentary, Tomson Highway: Permanent Astonishment, directed by Cree-Métis filmmaker Barbara Todd Hager and co-produced by Peter Raymont. The feature-length documentary is a White Pine Pictures and Barbara Hager Creative production for CBC and APTN supported by CMF, Telefilm Canada, Rogers Documentary Fund, FIBC, OFTTC and CAVCO.

item.title: [Vertical] Pendulum | Official Teaser (HD) | Vertical
item.description:
Married couple Patrick (Joseph Gordon-Levitt) and Abigail (Phoebe Dynevor) journey to a new-age retreat in New Mexico, drawn by the possibility of healing after a traumatic event. Patrick is willing to do anything to help his wife, but becomes distrustful of the retreat’s enigmatic leader (Jacki Weaver) even as Abigail falls under her spell. As paranoia builds, the couple must determine if the group’s spiritual practices offer genuine healing – or mask a terrifying truth that threatens to consume them both.

Starring: Joseph Gordon-Levitt and Phoebe Dynevor
